text:
Noah: FYI HW partner wants a 24-month accelerated commit: $1.5M year1 + $2.5M year2 if market adoption milestones hit. They want unused carryover between years and a guarantee on renewal pricing for year3. Ops and finance red flags?

Sofia: Carryover + renewal pricing together are dangerous. Suggest limited carryover cap (max 20% of year1) and explicit offsets so unused doesn't block other customers from Dedicated capacity.

Ethan: From infra: we must enforce per-offer token rate limits and a soft-priority queue. If partner consumes >70% of Dedicated for >48h, auto-route >threshold to public with lower-priority models. Need `carryover_enabled` + `carryover_cap_pct` fields on the offer.

Marina: Finance: renewal price guarantee ok but only if tied to clear GTM KPIs and a minimum committed renewal. Otherwise we risk revenue haircut. Also need to model revenue recognition for carryover credits.

Noah: Partner insists carryover is necessary for enterprise customers with seasonal usage. Can we propose a restricted carryover that expires after 90 days into next year?

Sofia: Yes, propose: carryover_allowed up to 20% and expires 90 days into the next term. Excess converts to marketing credit (non-transferable).

Ethan: Ops wants an activation hook: when carryover applies, mark quota as "soft_reserved" so autoscaler knows not to pre-allocate GPUs permanently. Also request a console badge: "Carryover active".

Marina: Add a renewal clause: if partner wants price floor for year3, require either (a) 60% of year2 consumed by EOM term OR (b) signed LOI by day 45 post-term; otherwise floor void. Keeps them incented.

billing-bot: Query run: SELECT offer_id, year1_commit, year2_option, carryover_pct, used_30d FROM mp_offers WHERE partner='hw-collective' ORDER BY updated_ts DESC LIMIT 1;
Result: offer_id=hc-2026-09, year1_commit=1500000, year2_option=2500000, carryover_pct=0, used_30d=200000

Noah: used_30d=200k is healthy but not alarming. Present partner with option: staged carryover (20% cap) + 90d expiry + activation notification tied to partner portal.

Sofia: Legal needs sample language for: carryover mechanics, expiry, conversion to credits, and our right to throttle if infra impact. I'll draft a short annex.

Ethan: Also request an ops-runbook snippet: when `carryover_active` and Dedicated_saturation>75% for 24h -> trigger fallback + partner alert + automatic model downgrade. Label as P1 runbook item.

Marina: Finance: propose holding 5% of year2 option as security until 60 days after year1 term close if carryover used. Protects against sudden churn.

Noah: Announcement cadence: partner wants co-branded launch at start of year2 if option exercised. Recommend locking announcement only after tranche activation notice and after ops confirms fallback policy in place. Don't announce before we validate capacity.

Sofia: Also include SI credits clause: SI credits will vest on customer go-live, not on tranche activation, and expire 12 months after issuance. No upfront bulk credits.

Ethan: Implementation notes: new offer JSON fields needed: `carryover_allowed`, `carryover_cap_pct`, `carryover_expiry_days`, `soft_reserved_quota`, `fallback_model_policy`. Backlog estimate: 5 sprint-days for API + Console + alerting minimal.

Marina: Action items:
- Sofia: legal draft for carryover annex + throttle rights (EOD Tue)
- Ethan: rough implementation ETA and runbook P1 (tomorrow)
- Marina: finance hold/security proposal and revenue recognition notes (EOD)
- Noah: present updated term sheet to partner Thurs 11am PT

billing-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 02:00-02:30 UTC Saturday may impact quota enforcement; recommend partner avoid activation during that window.

Noah: Thanks all. Will consolidate and send redline. :rocket:
